about: A law the notation names owes a formula only when no law line with form=formula stands under it, whatever the last step of that line: the set the notation renders. A law with two formulas, a floor and a ceiling, owes none.

cases.name: obligations, D11-the-obligatory
cases.formula lines: law/D11-the-obligatory/floor and law/D11-the-obligatory/ceiling, form=formula, in src/laws/laws.bound

cases.name: the debts of every place and of the tree

red was: the notation's debt counted a formula only on a line whose scope ends in /formula, so obligations was told GREY law/D11-the-obligatory/formula for a law whose two formula lines render on three of its pages
